## Reconciliation variants

| Variant       | Bulk-iDEAL amount (cents) | Delta (cents) | Expected `card_statement.state` | Expected `credit_carry` (cents) | Tolerance used     |
|---------------|---------------------------|---------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------------|--------------------|
| clean         | 84732                     | 0             | settled                         | 0                                | exact match        |
| overpaid      | 84885                     | +153          | overpaid                        | 153                              | amount_5eur        |
| underpaid     | 84514                     | −218          | partially_settled               | 0                                | amount_5eur        |

The base `asn-camt053.xml` carries the clean amount. The two overlay
JSON manifests (`scenario-1-overpaid.json`, `scenario-1-underpaid.json`)
carry the alternate bulk-iDEAL amount and the expected state-machine
outcomes for the resolver tests to overlay on top of the base XML.

## Locked features

- General Withdrawal NL hand-off (Phase 4 deferred item resolved by Phase 5):
  the PayPal CSV row at line 14 carries `Bankstorting naar PP-rekening`
  with the destination IBAN `NL57ASNB0123456789` inferable from the
  parent-row counterparty linkage. The Phase 5 PayPal funding
  resolver creates a deterministic `chain_link` of
  `kind='paypal_funding'` from the parent PayPal `transfer_out` to
  the matching ASN row.
- Deterministic Reference-Txn-ID chain at CSV lines 8–10
  (parent payment + Bankstorting funding sweep): the parent row
  reference appears verbatim in the child's `Reference Txn ID` cell.
- FX-conversion four-row chain at CSV lines 11–14
  (USD parent + EUR Bankstorting + EUR Algemene-valutaomrekening +
  USD Algemene-valutaomrekening), the empirical Phase 4 D-60(e) shape.
